count_arithmetic_correction: The plan's Steps/Acceptance sections state the expected total as 3*(37-7)=90, treating the noindex set as 7 EN_ROUTES entries. In the actual code, EN_ROUTES has 37 entries but only 6 of them are noindex routes (/corporate-training, /online-executive-mba, /programmes/shift-hr, /lp/google, /lp/meta, /unsubscribed). The 7th noindex item named in the research doc and the plan's Constraints section is the `/` root stub, which is NOT an EN_ROUTES entry (English home lives at /home, per locale-routes.ts) and therefore was never going to be counted by a `3*(EN_ROUTES.length - NOINDEX_ROUTES.length)` formula. The correct total is 3*(37-6)=93. This was verified live: `curl -s http://localhost:3114/sitemap.xml | grep -c '<loc>'` returned 93, and `npm run audit:release` independently reported '93 indexed pages'. NOINDEX_ROUTES in src/lib/locale-routes.ts has 6 entries; the test's exact-count assertion uses the same live formula (3 * (EN_ROUTES.length - NOINDEX_ROUTES.length)) so it is self-consistent and will not drift.
